mcqs.learning_point: सादगी और दिखावे के अंतर को समझना
mcqs.question: In Premchand’s story “फटे जूते”, how does the author differentiate between सादगी (simplicity) and दिखावा (showiness)?

options.A: सादगी denotes genuine modesty and honesty, whereas दिखावा denotes outward pretence of wealth
options.B: Both terms mean the same thing
options.C: सादगी is about wealth, while दिखावा is about poverty
options.D: सादगी refers only to clothing style, while दिखावा refers only to language

mcqs.answer: सादगी denotes genuine modesty and honesty, whereas दिखावा denotes outward pretence of wealth
mcqs.explanation: The story contrasts the protagonist’s honest, modest life with characters who flaunt wealth superficially. Option A correctly captures this contrast. Options B, C and D misinterpret the meanings of the terms.

mcqs.learning_point: लेखक के व्यंग्यात्मक दृष्टिकोण को पहचानना
mcqs.question: Which statement best reflects Premchand’s satirical viewpoint in “फटे जूते”?

options.A: He praises the rich for their generosity
options.B: He mocks society’s obsession with outward appearance over inner worth
options.D: He focuses only on romantic love

mcqs.answer: He mocks society’s obsession with outward appearance over inner worth
mcqs.explanation: Premchand uses satire to criticize how people value external show more than true character, which is expressed in option B. The other options do not represent his satirical stance.

mcqs.learning_point: चित्र और पाठ के संबंध को समझना
mcqs.question: What is the relationship between the illustration and the text in “फटे जूते”?

options.B: The picture is unrelated decorative art
options.C: The picture reinforces the theme of outward show versus inner reality
options.D: The picture explains the plot in detail

mcqs.answer: The picture reinforces the theme of outward show versus inner reality
mcqs.explanation: The illustration visually emphasizes the gap between external appearance and inner character, supporting the story’s theme, which is described in option C. Options A, B and D do not describe the actual relationship.

mcqs.learning_point: पाठ के निहित सामाजिक संदेश को समझना
mcqs.question: What social message does Premchand convey through the narrative of “फटे जूते”?

options.D: One should not judge people solely by external appearance

mcqs.answer: One should not judge people solely by external appearance
mcqs.explanation: The story warns against making judgments based on outward looks, urging readers to look beyond superficiality. Option D states this message; the other options are unrelated to the story’s theme.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is a characteristic of the satire used by Premchand in “फटे जूते”?

options.A: Use of irony to expose social hypocrisy
options.D: Purely factual narration without any humor

mcqs.answer: Use of irony to expose social hypocrisy
mcqs.explanation: Premchand’s satire relies on irony to highlight societal contradictions and hypocrisy, making option A correct. Options B, C and D describe other literary styles, not satire.

mcqs.learning_point: प्रेमचंद के व्यक्तित्व के संदर्भ को समझना
mcqs.question: If Premchand were to comment on today’s social‑media culture, which viewpoint would most likely align with his perspective expressed in “फटे जूते”?

options.A: He would celebrate the popularity of influencers
options.B: He would criticize superficial display of status over genuine values
options.C: He would encourage everyone to buy expensive gadgets
options.D: He would ignore modern trends entirely

mcqs.answer: He would criticize superficial display of status over genuine values
mcqs.explanation: Premchand’s focus on the gap between appearance and reality suggests he would critique modern superficiality, matching option B. The other options contradict his literary stance.

mcqs.learning_point: सादगी और दिखावे के अंतर को समझना
mcqs.question: Which of the following statements is a common misconception about सादगी (simplicity)?

options.B: Showiness is the same as simplicity

mcqs.explanation: Many think simplicity implies a lack of drive, which is incorrect; simplicity refers to modesty, not ambition. Option C captures this misconception. Options A, B and D are either inaccurate or unrelated.

mcqs.learning_point: लेखक के व्यंग्यात्मक दृष्टिकोण को पहचानना
mcqs.question: Why does Premchand employ satire to discuss the contrast between सादगी and दिखावा in “फटे जूते”?

options.D: To make readers reflect on societal values by highlighting contradictions

mcqs.answer: To make readers reflect on societal values by highlighting contradictions
mcqs.explanation: Premchand’s satirical tone is intended to provoke critical thinking about social values, as expressed in option D. Options A, B and C do not explain the purpose of his satire.
